libs.note: BH-8079: the project-21 dependency check of every build. bin/project-21-check.sh sends the build worktree's tracked lockfiles to ${PROJECT_21_BASE_URL-https://project-21.example}/v1/check in one request after the push; bin/lib/rb/pr.sh puts the `## Dependency advisories (project-21)` section in the PR body; the self-check rule project-21-upgrade makes each affected row with a fix a lead-review NOTE. A tripwire: no value of any knob here stops a build. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply project-21 (project-21_knobs); tests/project-21-check.bh-8079-test.sh, tests/project-21-pr-section.bh-8079-test.sh and tests/project-21-review-note.bh-8079-test.sh drive it.

knobs.note: 1 = every build checks its lockfiles with project-21, 0 = no call and no PR body section (pipeline.log says project-21 state=off). Read by bin/project-21-check.sh through project-21_knobs as ${PROJECT_21_ENABLED:-1}.

0 = an affected dependency with a fix the PR does not apply is a NOTE in the lead review request; 1 = the self-check rule project-21-upgrade REFUSEs it and holds the lead review. Read by project-21_psc_check (bin/lib/project-21.example) as ${PROJECT_21_REVIEW_BLOCK:-0}.

curl --max-time of the one project-21 request; the call sits on the build's path to its PR, after the push. A timeout is `check failed (curl rc=28)`. Read by bin/project-21-check.sh as ${PROJECT_21_TIMEOUT_S:-30}.

The most affected rows, and the most skip lines, the PR body section lists; the rest is one `... and <n> more` line that names $BUILD/project-21.json. Read by project-21_pr_section as ${PROJECT_21_ROWS_MAX:-50}.
The most characters of one field (a table cell or a skip line) in the PR body section. Read by project-21_pr_section as ${PROJECT_21_FIELD_MAX:-200}.
The most project-21-upgrade NOTE (or REFUSE) lines one self-check prints; the rest is one `and <n> more` line. Read by project-21_psc_check as ${PROJECT_21_NOTE_MAX:-10}.
